title: permissionUnitLocation
responsibility: Links only units registered in the shown permission revision.

inputs.name: permissionUnitLocation.host
inputs.description: Shown registry and route; entities are searched before reading the route, including when no unit matches.

inputs.name: permissionUnitLocation.id
inputs.description: Exact registered unit ID; no default or inferred category is supplied.

outputs.name: permissionUnitLocation
outputs.description: The registered unit route under its own category at the shown branch and commit; null when absent.

errors.name: Input access failure
errors.description: Errors from supplied getters, collection methods or species constructors propagate unchanged.
